description: Has the user sign in to Huasheng: they approve on a Bilibili page in their own browser. **Their password never passes through us**; only a token comes back. Use it when a tool reports NO_CREDENTIAL or an expired session. The first call returns pending=true (not a failure) and authorize_url; call again to check, or with code as that result explains.

code.description: The 127.0.0.1 address the browser ended on after approving, when it would not load

name: huasheng_login

authorize_url.description: Page the user opens to approve

pending.description: Awaiting browser approval; call again to check

title: Sign in to Huasheng
